column1: # Runtime voice: the Spanish of the subtitle templates, so the voice says the same as the subtitle.
# UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line. No build step: restart KSP after a change.
# kind line:  key is the clip key of a template row. english is that row's english (a check, the tests compare it).
#             spanish holds one version per english version, split by |, in the same order. Leave out the [conditions].
#             A version may use the slots of its english version, or fewer.
# kind pool:  key is the pool, english the value as in pools.tsv (without [conditions]), spanish its Spanish.
#             Start with m: f: mp: or fp: (masculine, feminine, plural) when a line uses the value with an article.
# Spanish slots: {thing} the value as it is, {el thing} with el/la/los/las, {un thing} un/una/unos/unas,
# {del thing} del/de la/de los/de las, {al thing} al/a la/a los/a las. {thing:2} as in the english.
# {other} {self} {here} {vessel} {day} work as in the english. The voice reverses every word (loñapsE), so a body
# name is written backwards like in bodies.tsv ("nibréK" is heard as Kérbin). Names in ‹ › are said as names.
